description.value: Bean Around The World is a Vancouver-area specialty coffee roaster with over 30 years in the business, roasting small batches daily and sourcing beans from around the world. The brand operates multiple retail café locations across the region alongside a robust online subscription service. A touring cyclist stopping in can expect freshly roasted espresso and drip coffee in a well-established local coffee culture setting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms batwcoffee.com is the official Bean Around The World Coffees site, a specialty coffee roaster celebrating 30+ years in operation. However, every page on the website lists the address as '1462 Columbia Street, North Vancouver, BC V7J 1A2' — the roastery headquarters — while the OSM record places this cafe at 1846 West 57th Avenue, Vancouver; the fetched content does not include the Locations subpage, so the W 57th Ave retail address cannot be confirmed from the website. No amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content, which focuses on online coffee sales and subscriptions rather than in-café experience.
